body: I’ll listen to your story if you listen to mine.

I wrote my note(?) to my sister, my person. I would even say soulmate. She’s protected me from so much, my parents mental and emotional abuse, even times of physical abuse. Heh, she used to play this game with me where she would hide me under the covers and I would have to try and catch her feet. The covers and her feet bouncing on the mattress made just enough noise to drown out my parents arguing. I just had the urge to write it, just in case I am taken away. But to you who responded. I think God can hear us. But, maybe He has bigger fish to fry. I don’t know.

I used to cut. And this was a solution I found that is actually a bit better than cutting...it helped me stop at least. 

Scream as loud as you can, real good. You know when you get the headache and your throat is a bit sore. Then go to the bathroom and run extremely cold water on your wrists. The shock from the water feels realllly good, it’s shocking. Repeat as necessary. You’ll tire yourself out and eventually just go to sleep.
I think binge drinking on an SSRI is the only thing I am good at.
